“Artificial arrives with off-screen baggage that has only raised its profile. #Amazon #MGM Studios developed and financed the film, but in June announced that they would not release it. The timing raised eyebrows because, four months before that, Amazon invested $50m in a partnership with #OpenAI, where #Altman is CEO. 

Amazon's only comment has been its statement, "We believe that #Artificial will be better served if it were released by a different studio." #Guadagnino  said in a recent interview with The Hollywood Reporter, "The concept of a conflict of interest is a very important, let's say, elephant in the room here."
